source_metadata.title: Ratchet: How Reliable Must an LLM Judge Be to Retire a Skill?

extraction_limitations: Atoms are extracted from the uploaded v3 preprint and are not externally verified.
The paper is a preprint; peer-review status is not established by the source itself.
Formula-based theoretical claims are represented as qualitative_result atoms because the MVP quantitative_result schema requires a single decimal estimate.
The secondary SkillsBench comparison is tagged secondary_report to distinguish cited background evidence from results generated in this study.
No funding or conflict-of-interest atom was created because no explicit funding or conflict-of-interest disclosure was identified in the inspected source text.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human verification was performed.
